scripts.dev: cd frontend && npm run dev & npm run server:dev
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd .. && tsc --project server/tsconfig.json && npm run build:serverless
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && cd .. && tsc --project server/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.json && cd .. && tsc --project server/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test frontend/src/lib/verify.test.ts frontend/src/lib/state.test.ts tests/unit/verification-guards.test.ts tests/unit/a11y.test.ts tests/unit/retrieval-and-content.test.ts tests/unit/auth.test.ts tests/unit/tts.test.ts tests/unit/completeness.test.ts tests/unit/privacy-routing.test.ts tests/unit/eval-stats.test.ts tests/unit/trust-schema.test.ts tests/unit/injection.test.ts tests/unit/chunks.test.ts tests/unit/pdf.test.ts tests/unit/language-prompts.test.ts tests/integration/firebase-hybrid.test.ts
